title: The Hero Arrives
text: Right in the middle of that exchange, my Father raised his shield and charged at me. There was a nice, solid thud. I swung my spear at him, holding back a bit.
“Can you stand your ground against this? Meteor Thrust!”

I unleashed the Meteor Thrust at my Father. I was holding back, but this strike still had a bit more Attack Power than the attacks I used back then. My Father held his shield up to block it. Even when the star struck Father, it only sent a few sparks flying, and he deflected it as if it were nothing. He actually seemed to be in a pretty good mood.

And so, while following the pattern of the first world, we fought a battle that was slightly different. Filo-tan even cast a magical tornado. I wonder if the fact that it was weaker than in the first world was because she hadn’t received the great blessing of Filolial-sama yet.
“Ooogggghhhhhhhhhh!”

As I heard that cry and looked in that direction… the pig standing next to the Crimson Swine was being attacked by Big Sister. Huh? I’m pretty sure that was the Lazy Pig, but since it was a bit farther away, it wasn’t taking any hits from the Big Sister. I wonder why?
“Hide Mirage”
The Big Sister vanishes.
“Bubububu! Bububu!”
The Crimson Swine is squealing away. Oh? It seems he intends to flush out Big Sister. I’ll read the Magic and interfere.
“The Love Hunter, the Source of All Power, commands: Interpret the universe once more and dispel the wind that sweeps away illusions.”
“Anti-Wind Flasher”
I’m casting this under my breath.
“O-oink!?”
The Crimson Swine glared at his Finacée with utter loathing. I’m the culprit here!
“Huh? Ah… Anti-Wind Flasher”
Despite the significant delay, the Finacée pretended to coordinate with me and complete the spell.
“Do you have time to be distracted? Oh, and that princess over there seems to be pretty lousy at Magic!”

Even though my future Father knows the truth, he’s goading me and the Crimson Swine. As this exchange went on, the Lazy Pig kept drifting further and further away from the battlefield. Maybe he’s caught on and is thinking of making a run for it. Just then, a mirage appeared near the Crimson Swine.
“Oink!”
The Crimson Swine attacked, thinking he’d read the move. But that was Big Sister’s trap.
“Hmm… I didn’t expect Melty-chan’s interference to work this well, so I set a trap—but I suppose it’s fine.”

As if at a loss for how to react, Big Sister attacked the Crimson Swine, who was completely off-guard after being led by the illusion. The Crimson Swine spun around with a sharp twist and locked blades with the Big Sister. Guh… I’m holding back the urge to finish off the Crimson Swine with a support attack. Or rather… Lazy Pig, given your position, you could be covering the Crimson Swine, yet you’re just standing there watching.
“Oink-oink-oink!”
“To treat people like pebbles on a whim… you’re a pitiful one, aren’t you?”

Big Sister’s energy level seems a bit low, too. I wonder why? Anyway, I’ll turn my face toward Father and continue the fight. But no matter how much time passes, the Pope still hasn’t launched a surprise attack. Ah… He’s probably waiting until I look like I’m worn out before he makes his move. I have a pretty good idea of what’s going on… but to give my Father the certainty he wants and to play up the Crimson Swine’s desperation, I’ll go along with the act of being pushed back.
“Naofumi and I both need to be clashing and cornered. Pretend we’re worn out from using our Skills in this back-and-forth battle.”
I whisper instructions to my Father.
“Windmill!”
I summon a tornado to trap my Father inside. I’m holding back quite a bit, so it shouldn’t hurt or even tickle.
“Guuuuuuu…”
However, my Father followed my instructions and leaned back. Then, after the tornado dissipated, I drew my spear back and assumed a stance as if to deliver a follow-up strike.
“Use the Shield of Wrath. Burn me with your counterattack.”
“I’ll ask you later how you know the name of that shield…”
My Father nodded as he looked at the Crimson Swine and activated the Shield of Wrath. The spear slammed into my Father’s shield with a thud.
“Woooooooooooooooooo!”

With that, my Father unleashed a torrent of flames from the Shield of Wrath, trying to scorch me. From my current perspective, those flames are practically a gentle breeze. As expected of my Father—it seems he’s even managed to reinforce the Shield of Wrath a bit.
“Waaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaah!”
And so, I put on a show of being blown away.
“Bubububuh!?”
Father’s flames of rage nearly spread all the way to the Crimson Swine.
“Whoops!”

But it seems he held back out of concern for Big Sister. The Crimson Swine is making a sound as if he’s worried about me, but sensing the tide is turning against him, his feet are already starting to turn in the opposite direction. The Lazy Pig has already retreated even further back than the Crimson Swines. Over there, it’ll take time for Filo-tan to land a kick to save him from the Pope’s Judgment, won’t it?
“Not yet…!”
And so, even while cornered, he pretends to be a hero rising to his feet.
“What do you mean… ‘not yet’? You’re a bloody mess! Just give up already!”
Father joins in, acting like he’s gasping for breath.
“I… I simply cannot lose here. If I lose here, my Finacée—and my dear… Raphtalia-chan and Filo-tan—will all fall into the hands of the Shield Demon!”
I believe those were the lines, more or less.
“Finacée… I don’t need her at all, from the bottom of my heart!”
Huh? It looks like my Father has got something all mixed up. He’s staring right at the Crimson Swine. I’d really appreciate it if he’d cut me some slack—I’m risking my life here!
“I’ll definitely save them.”
“…Are you still going to keep this up?”
My Father is making a face that says he’s thoroughly fed up with this. I agree—it’s a total farce. Just come out already, Pope!
“Not yet… I can’t lose just yet, aaaaaah!”
Just as he said that, I heard the sound of applause. He’s finally come out. That was exhausting.
“Well… as expected of Spear, you have such a strong will. That was a good stalling tactic.”

The tense, electrifying aura of large-scale Ceremonial Magic is starting to fill the air. Well then, I suppose I’d better deal with this too. I’ll stop pretending to be out of breath and cast my spell. If I don’t, there’ll be collateral damage. Though, I’m sure my Father could probably handle it.

"I, The Love Hunter, command the heavens and the earth: I shall sever and reconnect the order of the universe, and expel the pus. O power of the Dragon Vein! Join forces with my Magical Power and the power of the hero—The Love Hunter, the very source of all power, commands: Interpret all things in the universe once more, absorb the power of darkness, and transform it into strength!’
“Al Liberation Absorb X!”
The light of Judgment pouring down is being sucked into the tip of my spear.
“B-b-buh-buh-buh-buh!”

The Crimson Swine is hopping around excitedly for some reason—I wonder what it’s so happy about? Ah, it’s probably just spouting some taunting lines at me. Well then… I know who it is, but I suppose I’ll ask anyway?
“What a sudden appearance! You!”
Saying that, I aim my spear at the Pope—the one who spoke those words—while radiating a killing intent.
“Wha—you absorbed the ‘Judgment’!? No…”
Speechless, the Pope addresses me with a creepy grin, cold sweat pouring down his face.
“Is it him?”
Father stops acting here and asks me a question, but I want him to play along for now!
Hey, identify yourself! Why are you staying silent?
“Who are you?!”
I’ve got no choice but to make him introduce himself!
“W-well now, I’m afraid I’ve been late in introducing myself. I am the Pope of the Three Heroes Church.”
“The Pope… huh.”
Father said this in a somewhat weary tone, different from the one he used in the first world.
“Motoyasu neutralized it, but to launch such a powerful-looking attack right where this country’s princess is… what on earth are you thinking?”
The Pope raised both hands in a haughty gesture, then pressed them together as if rubbing them.
“I attacked with complete confidence that those under the protection of the Spear Hero—who possesses godlike power—would never be harmed by our attack.”
He sure has a way with words.
“Well then… Spear Hero, let us join forces and defeat the Demon of the Shield, who is shaking the very foundations of our nation.”
“Bubhee! Bububu! Bubu!”

The Crimson Swine seized the moment to start squealing and wailing, causing my Father and the others to look thoroughly displeased. It’s obvious at a glance that he’s not saying anything decent. For starters, what he’s saying is quite different from my memories. Why on earth is the Pope trying to flip-flop right here?
“—Don’t be fooled!”
Just then, a mysterious voice rang out loudly. Hmm? That voice sounds familiar.
“What’s going on now?”
My fathers-in-law turned their gaze toward the voice. And there, before them…
“What on earth is that!?”
“A flying… Filo-chan?”
“Huh? Filo’s right here, isn’t she?”
“So that means a flying Filolial!?”
My fiancée points at the source of the voice and exclaims excitedly. Indeed. There, right before our eyes, is Fleon-chan, who has just descended from the sky.
“B-b-bwaaaah…”
Oh? A stalker pig is clinging desperately to Fleon-chan’s back.

“For the sake of his own ambitions—even as the world faces crisis—he interferes with the cooperation between heroes, and to top it off, he pins all the blame on a hero who had been accumulating good deeds, erasing him from this world, all to rule the world as he pleases! That evil scheme! This… Philorial Mask No. 2 has been watching and listening to the Three Heroes Church’s actions every single step of the way! I’ve already investigated the entire sequence of events!”
The moment Fleon-chan lands in her Filolial form, mask covering her face, she strikes a pose. Glitter☆ It reminds me of the days when she was doing idol activities with Yuki-chan and the others.

“Yes… that’s right. As soon as Naofumi—the masked saint known throughout Melromarc as the ‘Sage of the Divine Bird’—realized the people’s trust was beginning to waver, he committed a series of crimes across the land, attributing them all to Naofumi, the ‘Sage of the Divine Bird’ and the Shield Hero, in an attempt to ruin his reputation. Such actions… this Perfect Justice absolutely cannot overlook them.”

Just then, Itsuki—who had just climbed down from Fleon-chan’s back while wearing the Filolial mask—spoke in a voice devoid of emotion. Furthermore, as if to match Fleon-chan, he struck a pose with his bow drawn. And she’s giving a sultry glance while pointing the bow upward.
By the way… Hyde is missing. Itsuki, you’re such a scatterbrain. Ah, since she’s masked right now, she’s Perfect Justice, isn’t she?
“Justice-san! Didn’t we agree on ‘Filolial Mask No. 3’?”
“Yes, that’s why it’s Perfect Justice, aka Filolial Mask V3.”
“B-bueeeee… buebue, bueeeeeee!”

The stalker pig is making some kind of noise… I wonder what it’s saying? Soon, Fleon-chan transformed into an angel and struck a pose alongside Itsuki. There was a loud “boom” like an explosion from behind.

I happened to glance at my Father, and he’s got a face that looks like one of those cat images with the universe in the background. My Finacée’s eyes are sparkling. Then, in a flash, she looked at the feather I gave Fleon-chan, and she’s glancing back and forth between me and Fleon-chan. Oh, did she notice? As expected of my Finacée—she’s quick on the draw.
“Bubuhi! Bububu! Bubuhi!”
The Crimson Swine is squealing something—what should we do? Seriously, what on earth is he saying?

“That’s exactly what I’ve been saying! A hero of justice will never bow to evil! Adventurer Myne, your wicked and heinous deeds will eventually be brought to justice! I won’t let you lay a finger on the Saint of the Divine Bird!”
Oh, it seems the Crimson Swine was saying something to Fleon-chan, who had butted in from the side.

“We’ve been traveling around the land, defeating the villains who impersonate Naofumi-san, and uncovering the true identities of those behind them. Pope of the Three Heroes Church, don’t think you’ll be able to wriggle out of this…”
Itsuki—aka Perfect Justice—pointed at the Pope and declared, his mask still on.
“Cha-cha-cha!”

Just then, as if it were background music, Fleon-chan began to sing. Oh, what a lovely song. Her voice—sounding like her own unique arrangement of a Super Sentai theme song I remembered because she loves heroes—echoed through the air.
“Ah… aaaah… uuuu…”
In time with the music, Itsuki lets out a strange sound—a mix of ecstasy and sheer astonishment. He must be deeply moved. After all, Itsuki is a musical genius!
“C… Come on! Now is the time to show justice! The truth will be revealed!”
Soon, Itsuki’s gaze sharpened as if he’d just taken a drug, and he aimed his bow at the Pope.
“Hey… you don’t have the Shield of Brainwashing, but don’t you have the Song of Brainwashing?”
His father is nudging his fiancée and asking her that.
